name: path-geometry
description: A small TypeScript geometry library for 3D paths, curves, frames, and mesh generation.
author: shawn0326

scripts.site:dev: npm run docs && npm run dev --workspace=@path-geometry/site
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=@path-geometry/site
scripts.pages:build: npm run site:build && npm run docs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run typecheck --workspace=@path-geometry/site
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test
